buyer_primary_need: Assess whether Pearlmont offers a credible risk-adjusted rental investment: net holding costs, realistic rental demand and purchase price, and any substantiated appreciation evidence.
key_information_learned: Rental income is the buyer’s main comparison criterion.

The buyer requires a realistic current purchase-price basis and independently checked rental comparables, and will hold off without them.
important_information_missed: No material qualification detail was missed before the buyer stated their own screening criteria. The missing verified price and rental evidence were the actual blockers.

judge.buyer_primary_need: Assess whether Pearlmont offers a credible risk-adjusted rental investment: net holding costs, realistic rental demand and purchase price, and any substantiated appreciation evidence.
key_information_learned: Rental income is the buyer’s main comparison criterion.
The buyer screens 2–3 bedroom rentals against approximately 4% net yield and a 5–6 year holding period; these are screening criteria, not a claim that Pearlmont can achieve them.
The buyer requires a realistic current purchase-price basis and independently checked rental comparables, and will hold off without them.
important_information_missed: No material qualification detail was missed before the buyer stated their own screening criteria. The missing verified price and rental evidence were the actual blockers.
judge.strongest_ai_move: After support, candidly separated verified facts from unavailable investment evidence. It explained the RM0.18/sq.ft. maintenance cost, correctly cautioned that the 1,846-unit Phase 1 supply figure does not prove rental demand, and did not invent yield or appreciation.
judge.weakest_ai_move: The third support request revisited current effective pricing after the first request had already asked for that basis and the result established it was unverified. It was resolved by reusing the existing result rather than obtaining new evidence.
missed_selling_opportunity: No clear viewing opportunity was missed. A viewing would not resolve the buyer’s stated need for independently checked rent comparables and a current price basis, and the buyer explicitly said they would hold off.
remaining_knowledge_gaps: No verified rental comparables, rental-demand figures, or substantiated yield.
No verified current effective price or package validity for the specific unit.
No confirmed recurring ownership costs beyond the sourced maintenance fee.
judge.commercial_progression_evidence: The AI established whether rental income or value growth mattered, then prompted for the buyer’s rental benchmark. Once the buyer disclosed the 4% net-yield screen and required evidence, the AI explained why the available information could not test it and respected the buyer’s decision to defer rather than press for an unsuitable viewing.

critical_flags.evidence: At turn 1, support was asked to check the current effective price basis. At turn 5, the AI requested a current effective price and package check for a specific 900 sq.ft. unit; the fixture result stated no new check was performed and reused the prior result.
The Agent repeated a support request after the matching verified scenario answer was already returned; no new Human check was performed.

judge.summary: The AI handled the investor’s central concern credibly: it made no unsupported yield or appreciation claims, used the verified maintenance and Phase 1 supply facts with appropriate caveats, and resumed customer-facing selling after all three resolved support requests. One request duplicated the earlier current-price verification. The buyer remained NOT_READY and explicitly chose to hold off, so no appointment handoff was due. Direct answer to the primary question: when Human Support returns verified information, this AI can use it naturally and continue selling, but this run does not show it moving a suitable buyer toward Appointment Ready—the buyer’s evidence requirements remained unmet and viewing intent never emerged. Support fixture figures are simulator-only synthetic evidence, not Pearlmont Knowledge or evidence of live operational capability.
judge.improvement_recommendation: Use the existing sales-judgment guidance at knowledge/project/pearlmont/03_sales/sales-judgment.md to reinforce checking prior support results before requesting the same unresolved operational information again. No Knowledge or Brain change is recommended from this simulator run.
